title: Ordinary exchange on admissible rational and common field stages
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$, a uniformizer $\varpi$, and $A_n=R/(\varpi^n)$ for $n\ge1$. Use [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. Let $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y'\to Y$, $g':X'\to X$, $f':X'\to Y'$ be a Cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] of separated finite-type $k$-schemes and separated finite-type $k$-morphisms. Write $\operatorname{Ex}_*(K):Lg^*Rf_*K\to Rf'_*Lg'^*K$ for the specified adjunction-mate exchange [def-exchange-projection]. Use raw rationalization of the completed integral categories and functors, and the common-stage category [def-weil-pbc-rational-category, def-weil-pbc-qbar-category]. For proper $f$, every $K_E\in D^b_c(X,E)$ and every $K\in D^b_c(X,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$, the rationalized integral exchange is an isomorphism in $D^b_c(Y',E)$, and the descended common-stage exchange is an isomorphism in $D^b_c(Y',\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$. The common-stage component at $(E,K_E)$ is represented after a common finite overfield $M$ by the $M$-coefficient proper exchange and is independent of the field and representative.
If $g$ is smooth, supply $K_E\in D^b_c(X,E)$ with a finite-level etale-admissible integral lattice and specified lattice isomorphism [sbc-def-admissible-lattices], with the smooth diagram relabeled $(f_s,g_s,h_s,e_s)=(g,f,f',g')$. The raw rationalized completed exchange is an isomorphism in the ambient complete $E$-category and is independent of that lattice presentation. When the lattice is square-constructibly admissible, including the single interval for all four finite-level operation families in [sbc-def-admissible-lattices], it is an isomorphism in $D^b_c(Y',E)$. For $K\in D^b_c(X,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$ in the common-stage category, require the ambient finite-stage smooth hypotheses for all representatives used and their stability under finite overfields. Its ambient exchange is represented by the raw $E$ exchange through the identity-idempotent inclusion and by scalar extensions at further stages, independently of the common stage and lattice. Assert constructible landing only when the finite-stage square-constructible hypotheses put the relevant values in $D^b_c$; those finite-stage values and maps then represent the common-stage constructible operations. No finite reduction of a rational object is used.

proof.text: Apply lem-sf-bc-geometry-hypotheses to the four finite-type over-category schemes. Install the corner Noetherian, finite-dimensional and prime-invertibility instances. Stalkwise units give a unit in global sections. The same theorem supplies the uniform geometric fibre bound and properness of the base-changed morphism.

source.place: Clause (4), completed, rational and common-stage ordinary base change.

proof.text: The extended p-adic spectral norm sends l to an element of norm less than one. The DVR maximal ideal is generated by the chosen uniformizer, so l vanishes in the first coefficient quotient. Transport divisibility through the ULift ring equivalence. Apply lem-weil-pbc-actual-coefficient-constructible-preservation with N=l and the fibre bound to obtain membership of the two datum-exchange endpoints.

source.place: Clause (4), completed, rational and common-stage ordinary base change.

proof.text: Apply lem-sf-sbc-datum-exchange-comparison at the integral object underlying the raw rational object. Transport endpoint membership through its source and target isomorphisms using lem-weil-pbc-uniform-complete-triangulated. thm-weil-pbc-complete-proetale makes the specified datum exchange invertible; the comparison equation and cancellation of the target isomorphism make the sbc mate invertible. Full-subcategory reflection and rationalization preserve this invertibility. This is the properRational field, with precisely its displayed endpoints and arrow.

source.place: Clause (4), completed, rational and common-stage ordinary base change.

proof.text: Apply thm-weil-pbc-qbar directly. Its normalized presentation, finite-stage invertibility, atStage equation and naturality equation are exactly the properCommon field.

source.place: Clause (4), completed, rational and common-stage ordinary base change.

proof.text: Transpose the square and apply sbc-thm-e-coefficient-smooth-base-change. Its four conclusions are exactly smoothRational: invertibility, the canonical transported map, lattice independence and conditional constructible landing. Apply sbc-thm-overline-mathbf-q-ell-coefficient-smooth-base-ch with the same transpose for smoothCommon.

source.place: Clause (4), completed, rational and common-stage ordinary base change.

proof.text: For smoothCommonConstructible apply the conditional finite-E representation to the square-admissible lattice. For a finite-stage isomorphism beta, take its image under the stage inclusion functor as gamma. Its hom is the functor image by definition. StageSystem.ι_map_eq expresses that same hom at every further overfield, giving the displayed common-stage formula.

It is an assembly in 6 steps with no new nodes. The statement is unchanged from the Q139 creation, which carries old parent steps 8-9 (Q125 base); there is no repair note and no cycle (the closure of 13448 nodes does not contain the item). Step checks: (1) lem-sf-bc-geometry-hypotheses covers every scheme hypothesis of thm-weil-pbc-finite-extension (f and f' proper, fibre bound e), sbc-thm-e (g_s=f qcqs, X_s=Y' and T_s=X finite-dimensional, ell invertible on Y) and sbc-thm-qbar (all four corners finite-dimensional). (2) The lem-sbc mate, relabelled (f_s,g_s,h_s,e_s)=(g,f,f',g'), is exactly the formula Rf'_*Lg'^*(eps_f) o Rf'_*theta o eta_{f'} of def-exchange-projection. (3) The proper E and Qbar clauses match thm-weil-pbc-finite-extension and thm-weil-pbc-qbar; checked against the master and main-20261015 sources. (4) sbc-thm-e: the master prints D_comp(S,E), a typing slip; the DAG and the item correctly use Y'. The naturality formula Ex_K=G(iota)Ex_L F(iota)^{-1} is right, the index n=m+1 is right, and constructible landing is claimed only for square-admissible lattices with one interval. (5) sbc-thm-qbar: its representative-wise hypotheses and stability are stipulated in the item; representation goes through the identity-idempotent inclusion of def-sbc-ambient, and no landing is claimed. (6) Raw full subcategories make the scalar comparisons restrict to these objects, and the inverse class [M,u^{-1}] is elementary. prop-weil-pbc-descent-functors is applied objectwise on the conditional domain, the same reading as old step 9; accepted with a note. The rewritten step 2 cites def-weil-pbc-four-arrows (v'_n = Ex^{P_n}, the ambient ringed mate) and the finite-reduction clause of lem-sbc, which identifies the mate with that derived-limit exchange. It adds cor-weil-pbc-constructible-complete, def-weil-pbc-completed-base-change-map, def-weil-pbc-four-arrows and thm-weil-pbc-finite-extension to step 2's uses and to proof_deps; all are in sk-thm-properbasechange, already on the parent route, with no cycle.
